description: Synthetic evaluation history of one salaried employee at a fictional employer, from 1 January 2025 to 31 December 2026, read at 2026-12-31T23:00:00-05:00. Every record is synthetic: the product, the employer, the people, the bank accounts and the plans are fictional, and nothing was collected. A development script replays a scripted history, with sick days and mileage lines from a seeded PRNG, through the App's own hooks, so the App computed every deduction, net pay, deposit and leave accrual.

sources.description: Scripted synthetic history with seeded random variation; no external collection and no real person, employer, bank or carrier. Dates are represented event dates of the fictional history, not collection dates.

generation.method: scripted replay with a seeded PRNG (mulberry32)

transformations: None. The seed is the App state after the replay, with the yearly salary in effect at the clock.

review.notes: Automated checks do not replace human review of realism and variation.
